descriptions.zh:
建设星际帝国绝非易事。

为了保证你早日走上正规，我会提供一系列教学§S任务§!，帮你了解建设成功的星系强权所必经的步骤。

要打开§S任务§!；

£dot_green£在左侧栏点击§S情报日志§!按钮或按§SF1§!

                        £situation_log£
descriptions.en:
Building a star empire can be a daunting task.

To help get things started, I will be providing instructional §SMissions§! that cover the basic steps necessary to establish ourselves as a successful interstellar power.

To access the §SMissions§!;

£dot_green£Click the §SSituation Log§! button on the left side bar or press §SF1§!

                        £situation_log£

descriptions.zh: 很好，我会在你探索游戏的过程中给予建议，并解释各种工具的基本功能。
descriptions.en: Very well. I will provide tips and explain the basic functions of the various tools as you explore them.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一个§S异常现象§!！

有时候，我们的£science_ship£§S科研船§!会在探索宇宙的过程中发现一些奇怪的事情。

如果£scientist£§S科学官§!的等级足够的话，他们就能研究§S异常现象§!。

被发现但是尚未研究的§S异常现象§!会被列在§S情报日志§!的§S异常现象§!选项卡里。在殖民或是进行其它建设之前，£planet£§S行星§!上的异常现象必须先被研究。
descriptions.en:
We have found an §SAnomaly§!!

From time to time, our £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! will make these discoveries while surveying alien worlds.

§SAnomalies§! can be researched by a £scientist£ §SScientist§!, if their skills are up to the task!

Unresearched §SAnomalies§! are listed under the §SAnomalies§! tab in the §SSituation Log§!. Some must be investigated before the £planet£ §SPlanet§! they were found on can be colonized or utilized.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一艘£science_ship£§S科研船§!发现了十分适合作为我们第一个£colony£§S殖民地§!的星球。它和我们母星的§S行星类型§!相同，所以我们的殖民者应该可以住得很舒适。

要殖民这个星球的话，要先拓展我们的边界。

选中£construction_ship£§S工程船§!；

£dot_green£右键点击一个调查完毕且含有潜在殖民地的£system£§S恒星系§!
£dot_green£选择§S[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地§!

                            £colonizable£

当宣称拥有了该§S恒星系§!后，我们就可以开始殖民流程了。
descriptions.en:
One of our £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! has just surveyed a world that would make an excellent candidate for our first £colony£ §SColony§!. It is of the same §Splanet class§! as our homeworld, so our colonists should be quite comfortable there.

Before colonizing this world, we must extend our borders.

With the £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! selected;

£dot_green£ Right-click a surveyed £system£ §SSystem§! containing a potential colony
£dot_green£ Select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase§!

                            £colonizable£

Once the §SSystem§! is claimed, we can begin the colonization process.

descriptions.zh:
祝贺你殖民了一颗新星球！殖民者正在建造他们的第一个殖民地，想要让他们自给自足，则还需要一段时间。

£colony£§S§!殖民地在第一个定居点建设完成完成前会不断消耗我们的资源，所以不要一次性对过多£planet£§S行星§!进行殖民。
descriptions.en:
Congratulations on having colonized a new world! Our colonists are now in the process of building their first settlement, but it will take time for them to become self-sufficient.

The £colony£ §SColony§! will be a drain on our resources until the first settlement has been completed, so take care not to colonize too many £planet£ §SPlanets§! at once.

descriptions.zh:
我们正以可怕的速度损失£energy£能量币，上个月的预算报表情况十分糟糕。

维护费是财政赤字的常见原因。如果不幸言中，则应该解散一部分飞船，部队或者拆除太空港。
descriptions.en:
We are losing £energy£ Energy Credits at an alarming rate. Last month's budget report makes for some grim reading.

Spiraling upkeep costs are a common cause of budget deficits. If this is the case, we may want to consider disbanding some of our ships, armies or stations.
